summary:
Main
Today DCE iron ore futures exhibited a firm trend, with the most active I2609 contract ultimatelysettling at 778.5 RMB per tonne, representing an increase of 0.39 per cent from the previous trading session. Conversely, physical spot prices experienced a decline of 3 to 5 RMB per tonne compared to the preceding day. Whilst traders actively presented their offers, steelmakers procured strictly on an as-needed basis, resulting in a scarcity of market inquiries and a largely muted overall physical transaction environment.
